answer: A voyage in epoch 125 is admitted only when the key posts a 13 POA bond and keeps one pearl sealed under a violet customs wire for the whole crossing. The public board stores one sealed pearl per key and checks the wire at intake and at landfall; a second seal, a reused pearl, or a wire opened early burns the 13 POA bond. A farm of 380 keys that can keep only ten pearl under seal admits only ten crossings, so 370 keys each burn 13 POA: 370 x 13 = 4,810 POA the attacker forfeits.
